title: Indonesian text translation basic path
purpose: Checks that the deterministic text translation functional path produces a result without requiring manual app testing.

title: English text translation basic path
purpose: Checks the opposite text translation direction through the functional scenario matrix.

title: Empty text input guard
purpose: Checks that empty translation input is rejected by the functional scenario instead of falling through to the engine.

title: Maximum text length guard
purpose: Checks that oversized translation input is represented as a pre-engine guard case.
